description: Trigger evals for component-spec: it fires when a single Figma component needs a full spec doc written for the design system, while screen-spec, image-to-spec, design-spec-review, pattern-doc and inventory-snapshot handle a screen frame, an image-only source, a review of built code, a reusable UX pattern, and a library-wide inventory.

should_trigger: Can you write up the Button component from our Figma file? I have the node link and it's an atom.
We are documenting the design system and the SearchField molecule is next. Here is the Figma URL with the node-id. I want every variant, size and state written down so a dev never has to open Figma.

The Figma library has a Chip component with filled, outlined and selected variants. Pull its tokens and spacing and produce the doc under docs/research/components/atoms, and mark whatever Figma does not show as proposed.
Next on the inventory is the Avatar. Read it straight from Figma, note the touch target and contrast numbers, and draft the props interface plus a usage snippet.
spec the ListItem organism from this Figma node, please

should_not_trigger.prompt: Here is the Figma frame for the Checkout screen. Document the layout, the components it uses, the copy and the error states.
I only have a PNG screenshot of a dropdown from the old app, no Figma file exists. Turn it into a structured spec for me.
The Toggle is already built in the repo and the spec doc exists. Check whether the code matches the documented variants, states and tokens.
We keep solving empty states differently on every page. Write up one reusable guideline for empty states that all our screens can follow.
Design shipped a new version of the Figma library. List every component in it, with its tier and whether we already have a spec, code or story for each, and show what changed since last time.
